title: For each non-deleted instance on host `blaze8-12` that has system metadata
question: For each non-deleted instance on host `blaze8-12` that has system metadata with key `image_image_type`, list the instance UUID, display name, the `image_image_type` metadata value, the number of network-info cache records, and the total memory (MB) summed across those cache records; also show the overall average cache-record count across these instances and label each instance as HIGH_CACHE/LOW_CACHE/AVERAGE_CACHE relative to that benchmark, and include (by matching display name) the maximum total vCPUs for that display name among instances in availability zone `flare3` on host `blaze8-12`. Do not return any rounded answers. Categorize each instance as `HIGH_CACHE` (at least 50% above average), `LOW_CACHE` (at least 50% below average), or `AVERAGE_CACHE`.

WITH base AS (
  SELECT i.uuid,
         i.display_name,
         m.value AS image_image_type
  FROM instances i
  JOIN instance_system_metadata m
    ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid
  WHERE i.host = 'blaze8-12'
    AND i.deleted = 0
    AND m.`key` = 'image_image_type'
),
cache_stats AS (
  SELECT b.uuid,
         b.display_name,
         b.image_image_type,
         COUNT(iic.id) AS cache_cnt,
         COALESCE(SUM(i.memory_mb), 0) AS total_memory_mb
  FROM base b
  LEFT JOIN instance_info_caches iic
    ON iic.instance_uuid = b.uuid
  JOIN instances i
    ON i.uuid = b.uuid
  GROUP BY b.uuid, b.display_name, b.image_image_type
),
avg_cte AS (
  SELECT AVG(cache_cnt * 1.0) AS avg_cache
  FROM cache_stats
),
flare AS (
  SELECT i.display_name,
         SUM(i.vcpus) AS total_vcpus
  FROM instances i
  WHERE i.host = 'blaze8-12'
    AND i.availability_zone = 'flare3'
    AND i.deleted = 0
  GROUP BY i.display_name
)
SELECT cs.uuid,
       cs.display_name,
       cs.image_image_type,
       cs.cache_cnt,
       cs.total_memory_mb,
       a.avg_cache,
       CASE
         WHEN cs.cache_cnt >= a.avg_cache * 1.5 THEN 'HIGH_CACHE'
         WHEN cs.cache_cnt <= a.avg_cache * 0.5 THEN 'LOW_CACHE'
         ELSE 'AVERAGE_CACHE'
       END AS cache_label,
       f.total_vcpus
FROM cache_stats cs
CROSS JOIN avg_cte a
LEFT JOIN flare f
  ON f.display_name = cs.display_name

WITH base AS (
  SELECT i.uuid,
         i.display_name,
         m.value AS image_image_type
  FROM instances i
  JOIN instance_system_metadata m
    ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid
  WHERE i.host = 'blaze8-12'
    AND i.deleted = 0
    AND m.`key` = 'image_image_type'
),
cache_stats AS (
  SELECT b.uuid,
         b.display_name,
         b.image_image_type,
         COUNT(iic.id) AS cache_cnt,
         COALESCE(SUM(i.memory_mb), 0) AS total_memory_mb
  FROM base b
  LEFT JOIN instance_info_caches iic
    ON iic.instance_uuid = b.uuid
  JOIN instances i
    ON i.uuid = b.uuid
  GROUP BY b.uuid, b.display_name, b.image_image_type
),
avg_cte AS (
  SELECT AVG(cache_cnt * 1.0) AS avg_cache
  FROM cache_stats
),
flare AS (
  SELECT i.display_name,
         SUM(i.vcpus) AS total_vcpus
  FROM instances i
  WHERE i.host = 'blaze8-12'
    AND i.availability_zone = 'flare3'
    AND i.deleted = 0
  GROUP BY i.display_name
)
SELECT cs.uuid,
       cs.display_name,
       cs.image_image_type,
       cs.cache_cnt,
       cs.total_memory_mb,
       a.avg_cache,
       CASE
         WHEN cs.cache_cnt >= a.avg_cache * 1.5 THEN 'HIGH_CACHE'
         WHEN cs.cache_cnt <= a.avg_cache * 0.5 THEN 'LOW_CACHE'
         ELSE 'AVERAGE_CACHE'
       END AS cache_label,
       f.total_vcpus
FROM cache_stats cs
CROSS JOIN avg_cte a
LEFT JOIN flare f
  ON f.display_name = cs.display_name
